# ProductGurus

> A Vancouver product studio for product discovery and prototyping, run by product manager Abhay Kumar with a roster of specialist AI systems. Seven products taken from research to release; every decision human-verified.

Contact: productgurus@proton.me · https://calendly.com/productgurus-proton/30min

## Services
- [What we do](https://productgurus.ai/what-we-do): discovery sprints (2–4 weeks), working prototypes (3–6 weeks), build-ready specs and handover for client engineering teams
- [About](https://productgurus.ai/about): who runs the studio; open to senior product roles in Vancouver

## Case studies
- [ShiftFlow PRO](https://productgurus.ai/projects/shiftflow): AI retail workforce scheduler, in production, compliance layer kept deterministic
- [Scrutas](https://productgurus.ai/projects/scrutas): forensic web audit platform, 23 modules, two-stage authorization model
- [Squint](https://productgurus.ai/projects/squint): website audit to client-ready pitch report for agencies
- [Council of AIs](https://productgurus.ai/projects/council-of-ais): open-source budget-driven multi-model router
- [Dwell](https://productgurus.ai/projects/dwell): renter trust score for Canadian newcomers, discovery in progress
- [PavIQ](https://productgurus.ai/projects/paviq): fleet-mounted road-condition sensing, validated concept
- [GridSentinel](https://productgurus.ai/projects/gridsentinel): battery-free grid-edge outage sensor, validated concept
